summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing management's unaudited estimate of net asset value per share as of August 31, 2026 of $13.66. No transaction, tender, strategic action or corporate event is announced. The filing is signed by Chief Financial Officer Jeffrey D. Fox on September 15, 2026. This is ordinary periodic NAV disclosure for a business development company and does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing conditions are stated. No risk-arb angle applies.
